sanskrit: yat te prajāyāṃ paśuṣu yad vā gṛheṣu niṣṭhitam aghakṛdbhir aghaṃ kṛtam | agniṣ ṭvā tasmād enasaḥ savitā ca pra muñcatām ||
english: Whatever evil has been wrought by evildoers upon your offspring, your cattle, or what is established in your houses — may Agni and Savitṛ release you from that sin.

sanskrit: iyaṃ nāry upa brūte pūlpāny āvapantikā | dīrghāyur astu me patir edhantāṃ pitaro mama ||
english: This woman speaks, scattering flower-blossoms: "May my husband have long life; may my fathers prosper."

sanskrit: ihemāv indra saṃ nuda cakravākeva dampatī | prajāvantau svastakau dīrgham āyur vy aśnutām ||
english: O Indra, unite this couple here like a pair of cakravāka birds. Blessed with offspring, auspicious, may they enjoy long life.

sanskrit: yad āsandyām upadhāne yad vopavāsane kṛtam | vivāhe kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakrur āsnāne tāṃ ni dadhmasi ||
english: Whatever sorcery was wrought upon the seat, the pillow, or the resting-place, whatever malefic rite was performed at the wedding bathing — that we now lay to rest.

sanskrit: yad duṣkṛtaṃ yac chamalaṃ vivāhe vahatau ca yat | tat saṃbhalasya kambale mṛjmahe duritaṃ vayam ||
english: Whatever misdeed, whatever defilement occurred at the wedding and in the wedding procession — all that trouble we wipe away upon the blanket of the saṃbhala.

sanskrit: saṃbhale malaṃ sādayitvā kambale duritaṃ vayam | abhūma yajñiyāḥ śuddhāḥ pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣan ||
english: Having deposited the impurity upon the saṃbhala, and the sin upon the blanket, we have become pure and fit for sacrifice; may they carry our life-spans forward.

sanskrit: yā me priyatamā tanūḥ sā me bibhāya vāsasaḥ | tasyāgre tvaṃ vanaspate nīviṃ kṛṇuṣva mā vayaṃ riśāma ||
english: That body of mine which is most dear to me is afraid of the garment. Do thou, O Lord of the forest, fashion her lower garment at the front — let us not suffer harm.

sanskrit: kṛtrimaḥ kaṅkataḥ śatadan ya eṣaḥ | apāsyāḥ keśyaṃ malam apa śīrṣaṇyaṃ likhāt ||
english: This is the crafted comb of the hundred-toothed kaṅkata tree. Let it scrape away the impurity of the hair, let it scratch away the impurity of the head.

sanskrit: aṅgādaṅgād yūyam asyā apa yakṣmaṃ ni dhattana | tan mā prāpat pṛthivīṃ mota devān divaṃ mā prāpan morv antarikṣam | apo mā prāpan malam etad agne yamaṃ mā prāpat pitṝṃś ca sarvān ||
english: From limb to limb, do you put down the disease away from her. Let it not reach the earth, nor the gods, nor heaven; let it not reach the wide atmosphere. Let it not reach the waters — this impurity, O Agni; let it not reach Yama and all the Fathers.

sanskrit: saṃ tvā nahyāmi payasā pṛthivyāḥ saṃ tvā nahyāmi payasauṣadhīnām | saṃ tvā nahyāmi prajayā dhanena sā saṃnaddhā sanuhi vājam emam ||
english: I bind you with the sap of the earth; I bind you with the sap of the plants; I bind you with offspring and with wealth. So bound and equipped, win this prize.

sanskrit: amo 'ham asmi sā tvaṃ dyaur ahaṃ pṛthivī tvam | mano 'ham asmi vāk tvaṃ tāv iha saṃ bhavāva prajām ā janayāvahai ||
english: I am ama, thou art sā; I am heaven, thou art earth. I am mind, thou art speech. So let us two come together here and beget offspring.

sanskrit: janīyanti no agravaḥ putrīyanti sudānavaḥ | ariṣṭāsaḥ sacemahi bṛhate vājasātaye ||
english: May the foremost among us long for a wife; may the generous ones long for a son. Unharmed, may we follow together for the great winning of strength.

sanskrit: ye pitaro vadhūdarśā imaṃ vahatum āgaman | te asyai vadhvai saṃpatnyai prajāvac charma yacchantu ||
english: The Fathers who, beholding the bride, have come to this wedding procession — may they grant to this bride, the mistress of the household, prosperous shelter with offspring.

sanskrit: yedaṃ pūrvāgan raśanāyamānā prajām asyai draviṇaṃ ceha dattvā | tāṃ vahantv agatasyābhi panthāṃ virāḍ iyaṃ suprajā aty ajaiṣīt ||
english: Those who have come before, stretching out the cord, having given offspring and wealth to her here — may they lead her along the path to what has not yet been reached. This virāj, rich in offspring, has conquered.

sanskrit: pra budhyasva subudhā budhyamānā dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya | gṛhān prehi sumanasyamānā dīrghaṃ ta āyuḥ savitā kṛṇotu ||
english: Awake fully, awaking with a good awakening, for long life, for a hundred autumns. Enter the houses with a well-disposed mind; may Savitṛ make your life long.

sanskrit: vi te muñcāmi raśanāṃ vi raśmīn vi yoktrāṇi paricartanāni ca | ariṣṭāsmin jyotiṣi śivā gṛhapatau bhava ||
english: I release your cord, I release your reins, I release the yoke-straps and the fastening bands. Unharmed, in this light be auspicious to your husband.

sanskrit: syonā bhava śvaśurebhyaḥ syonā patye gṛhebhyaḥ | syonāsyai sarvasyai viśe syonā puṣṭāyaiṣāṃ bhava ||
english: Be gentle to your fathers-in-law; be gentle to your husband and his household. Be gentle to this entire clan; be gentle for the flourishing of these people.

sanskrit: udehi vājin yo 'psv antar idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ pra viśa sūnṛtāvat | yo rohito viśvam idaṃ jajāna sa tvā rāṣṭrāya subhṛtaṃ pipartu ||
english: Rise up, O Vājin who dwells within the waters; enter this kingdom filled with truth. May Rohita, who engendered all this universe, carry you well-borne to sovereignty.

sanskrit: ud vāja āgan yo 'psv antar viśa ā roha tvadyonayo yāḥ | somaṃ dadhāno 'pa oṣadhīr gāś catuṣpado dvipada ā veśayeha ||
english: The vāja who is within the waters has risen up; enter and ascend to your own sources. Bearing Soma, settle here the waters, the plants, the cattle, the four-footed and the two-footed.

sanskrit: yūyam ugrā marutaḥ pṛśnimātara indreṇa yujā pramṛṇīta śatrūn | ā vo rohitaḥ śṛṇavat sudānavas triṣaptā marutaḥ svādusaṃmudaḥ ||
english: You mighty Maruts, sons of Pṛśni, yoked with Indra, smite down the enemies. May Rohita hear you, O generous ones; the thrice-seven Maruts, full of sweet joy.

sanskrit: ruho ruroha rohita ā ruroha garbho janīnāṃ januṣām upastham | tābhiḥ saṃrabdho anv avindat ṣaḍ urvīr gātuṃ prapaśyann iha rāṣṭram āhāḥ ||
english: He climbed, Rohita climbed, he climbed fully — the embryo upon the lap of the mothers and of the births. Grasping those, he found the six wide spaces; looking ahead to a path, he has proclaimed this kingdom here.

sanskrit: ā te rāṣṭram iha rohito 'hār mṛdho vy āsthad abhayaṃ te abhūt | tasmai te dyāvāpṛthivī revatībhiḥ kāmaṃ duhatām iha śakvarībhiḥ ||
english: Here Rohita has seized your kingdom; he has scattered your enemies; you have become fearless. For you, heaven and earth with their riches shall milk desire here with their mighty ones.

sanskrit: rohito dyāvāpṛthivī jajāna taṃ tantuṃ parameṣṭhī tatāna | tatra śiśriye 'ja ekapād adṛṃhad dyāvāpṛthivī balena ||
english: Rohita engendered heaven and earth; Parameṣṭhin stretched out that thread. There the unborn, the one-footed, took his seat; he firmly established heaven and earth with his power.

sanskrit: rohito dyāvāpṛthivī adṛṃhat tena sva stabhitaṃ tena nākaḥ | tenāntarikṣaṃ vimitā rajaṃsi tena devā amṛtam anv avindan ||
english: Rohita firmly established heaven and earth; by him the vault of heaven was propped up; by him the firmament was measured out and the realms spread; by him the gods found immortality.

sanskrit: vi rohito amṛśad viśvarūpaṃ samākṛṇvānaḥ praruho ruhaś ca | divaṃ rūḍhvā mahatā mahimnā saṃ te rāṣṭram anaktu payasā ghṛtena ||
english: Rohita touched all forms, gathering together both the sprouts and the climbers. Having climbed heaven with great greatness, may he anoint your kingdom with milk and ghee.

sanskrit: yās te ruhaḥ praruho yās ta āruho yābhir āpṛṇāsi divam antarikṣam | tāsāṃ brahmaṇā payasā vāvṛdhāno viśi rāṣṭre jāgṛhi rohitasya ||
english: Your climbers, your sprouts, your ascenders, with which you fill heaven and the atmosphere — nourished by the sacred word and by milk, be wakeful in the clan, in the kingdom of Rohita.

sanskrit: yās te viśas tapasaḥ saṃbabhūvur vatsaṃ gāyatrīm anu tā ihāguḥ | tās tvā viśantu manasā śivena saṃmātā vatso abhy eti rohitaḥ ||
english: Those clans of yours that were born from austerity, that followed the gāyatrī-calf — may they come here. May they enter you with an auspicious mind; the well-mothered calf Rohita comes toward you.
